name: Interstage Sand for Combined Wall+Ceiling Finish
intent: Light sand between finish coats on both substrates. Two sand tasks (each at its own ps_key so quantification is per-substrate correct) and one vacuum pass (single subfloor sweep).
doctrine: QT4/QT5 only — interstage sand between finish coats. Coat counts in the combined scenarios control when this module fires. Uses the ceiling vacuum task as the shared sweep (drop the per-wall vacuum to avoid double-count; the ceiling task sweeps the same subfloor).
